subject: general
question:
In the Venn diagram below, what is the sum of the numbers that represent all those athletes who are not disciplined?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53a12df40822bc9b2a37963917b84e4c9feea89065b81b4839da9c567f73161b.png]
solution:
We have to calculate the athletes who are not disciplined. So, we have to add the numbers that are in circle but not in rectangle. There numbers are 7 + 5 + 4 = 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb59a1f78952cc6ad2cc20a64cbdeed1d4de1ba205a5ee7b815ba3bea0f13742.png] 

Thus, the answer is 16.
